bayerlink_display.description: Raw Bayer frames in over a display link as bayerlink, the revela ISP, a raster out: a camera on a display, on any board that brings an HDMI front end, a transmitter, the clocks and a register bus. It names no board, no vendor and no ISP: the board fills `pipeline`, supplies the clocks and resets by role, and decides what sits between the receiver and the crossing.

pipeline.description: The ISP, by reference: a composite of revela's blocks with ports isp_in and isp_out, generated and proved as part of this design. The board chooses it.

mode.description: The output raster. By default the one the input arrives in, so the output runs at the input's rate: a 74.25 MHz raster genlocks to the stream, a 148.5 MHz one free-runs.

link_mode.description: The raster the receiver advertises in its EDID: payload plus one header row.

isp_mhz.description: The clock the pipeline is CUT for, above the clock it runs at: generation margin makes the cut placement deterministic.

rx_fifo.description: The receiver's sample FIFO depth, pinned: a different depth is a different design.

max_line_bytes.description: The longest packed camera line the receiver holds.

fill.description: What the raster paints outside the picture.

genlock.description: 1: the raster follows the stream's frame rate, stepping its clock's fine phase; the board decides, from the raster it builds.

lane_map.description: Which video lane carries container byte 0, 1, 2: the front end's fact, from the board.

vsync_active_high.description: The front end's frame-pulse polarity, from the board.

sample_bits.description: The depth of one sample into the ISP: the fact its input port declares, wired from here to everything carrying samples to it.

isp_width.description: The widest line the ISP is built for, as its input port declares it; the entry crops a wider one to it.

isp_out_bits.description: The ISP's output word, as its models trace it -- not declared anywhere: read from the ISP, wired from here to everything that carries it.

inputs.name: rx_pclk
inputs.description: The pixel clock the HDMI front end recovers from the cable; it stops when the cable is pulled.

inputs.name: rx_data
inputs.description: The front end's 24 data bits.

inputs.name: rx_de
inputs.description: The front end's data enable.

inputs.name: rx_vsync
inputs.description: The front end's frame pulse.

inputs.name: rx_locked
inputs.description: The front end has locked to the link.

inputs.name: isp_in
inputs.description: The receiver's stream, back from the board: straight from rx_out, or through whatever the board puts between (a capture switch).

inputs.name: stable_clk
inputs.description: A clock that never stops, for the link supervisor.

inputs.name: isp_clk
inputs.description: The clock the ISP and everything on its side runs on.

inputs.name: bus_clk
inputs.description: The clock of the register buses.

inputs.name: raster_clk
inputs.description: The display's pixel clock.

inputs.name: raster_locked
inputs.description: The display clock is locked.

inputs.name: raster_ps_done
inputs.description: The display clock's fine phase step is done (genlocked rasters).

inputs.name: en_grab
inputs.description: Feed the grab branch of the tee.

inputs.name: en_direct
inputs.description: Feed the direct picture branch of the tee.

inputs.name: broom
inputs.description: The software reset: clears the receiver's tallies, restarts the link supervisor and the raster.

inputs.name: isp_rst
inputs.description: The ISP side's reset, active high: the link's reset in that clock.

inputs.name: bus_resetn
inputs.description: The register buses' reset, active low.

inputs.name: bus_rst
inputs.description: The register buses' reset, active high.

inputs.name: scl_i
inputs.description: DDC clock, from the jack.

inputs.name: sda_i
inputs.description: DDC data, from the jack.

outputs.name: rx_out
outputs.description: The receiver's stream, to the board, which returns it on isp_in.

outputs.name: grab
outputs.description: The ISP's picture as AXI4-Stream, for a frame DMA.

outputs.name: raster
outputs.description: The display's video, to the HDMI transmitter.

outputs.name: rst_pix
outputs.description: The link's reset, in the cable's clock: the link supervisor's verdict.

outputs.name: raster_ps_en
outputs.description: A fine phase step requested of the display clock (genlocked rasters).

outputs.name: sda_pull
outputs.description: The DDC slave pulling SDA low.

isp_cdc.description: The receiver's stream into the ISP's clock: written in the pixel clock recovered from the cable, read in the ISP's, both sides reset by the link.
